# Line Icon Pack

> 406 line icons on a 24 px grid with an adjustable corner radius: presets original, rounded and sharp, plus solid fill and fill-sharp sets. Package line-icon-pack, installed from GitHub: SVG files, sprites, icon fonts (lip- classes), a JS API, React components, a CLI and an MCP server.

## Use

- Install: `npm install github:bilekpetr/line-icon-pack` (not on the npm registry; pin a tag with `#v0.1.0`)
- Find: `npx -y github:bilekpetr/line-icon-pack search "<words>"`; names are kebab-case like `users-add`, JS exports camelCase like `usersAdd`
- React: `import { UsersAddIcon } from 'line-icon-pack/react/icons'`
- JS: `import { toSvg } from 'line-icon-pack'; import { usersAdd } from 'line-icon-pack/icons'; toSvg(usersAdd, { preset: 'rounded' })`
- SVG file: `line-icon-pack/svg/<original|rounded|sharp|fill|fill-sharp>/<name>.svg`
- Font: `line-icon-pack/font/<set>/line-icon-pack-<set>.css` → `<i class="lip-<set> lip-<name>"></i>`
- MCP: `npx -y github:bilekpetr/line-icon-pack mcp` (tools search_icons, get_icon, list_categories, list_presets)

## Docs

- [README](README.md): every format with examples
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): how coding agents find and insert icons
- [Website](https://lineiconpack.com): browse, customise and copy
